metadata.title: MarketMind — Open-source trading workstation for Binance
metadata.description: Desktop app to chart, backtest and auto-trade crypto on Binance. 107 Pine Script strategies, paper wallets, risk limits you set, and an MCP bridge for AI agents. Runs on your own machine.

hero.title: Chart, backtest and auto-trade crypto
hero.description: MarketMind is a desktop trading workstation for Binance spot and futures. Multi-timeframe charts, 107 Pine Script strategies, a backtesting engine, auto-trading with risk limits you set, paper wallets and an MCP bridge for AI agents. The backend and the database run on your machine, so your API keys never leave it.
hero.platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) · Windows · MIT license

workflow.title: From chart to execution, in one app
workflow.subtitle: The setups you see on the chart are the same ones the screener, the backtests and the auto-trader use.

chart.title: Watch
chart.description: Open a symbol on several timeframes at once. Add indicators, volume profile, the liquidity heatmap and drawings, and trade straight from the chart.

detect.title: Detect
detect.description: Enable strategies and MarketMind marks setups on the chart as candles close. The confluence ladder scores each entry across timeframes before it fires.

backtest.title: Validate
backtest.description: Run the same strategies over years of stored candles with fees, filters and position caps. Compare the numbers before risking anything.

trade.title: Automate
trade.description: Start watchers on the symbols and timeframes you trust. Trading profiles decide sizing, stops, targets and filters. One button stops everything.

features.title: What is inside
features.subtitle: Everything below ships in the app today. Beta features are marked.

layouts.title: Multi-timeframe layouts
layouts.description: See the same symbol at 1m, 5m and 15m, or 1h, 4h and 1d, side by side, across 16 timeframes from one minute to one year. Layout presets hold charts, the order ticket, positions, the order book and metrics as resizable panels, and any chart can detach into its own window.

indicators.title: 45+ indicators, 20 drawing tools
indicators.description: Moving averages, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, Ichimoku, SuperTrend, VWAP and more, plus volume profile, liquidity heatmap, opening-range breakout and fair-value gaps. Fibonacci, pitchfork, channels, long and short positions and the usual lines, saved with undo and redo. 25 candle patterns, or define your own.

liveData.title: Live data that keeps moving
liveData.description: Candles stream from Binance and are stored locally in PostgreSQL, with history back to 2017 for spot and 2019 for futures. A watchdog reconnects silent streams, the chart opens the next bar itself when a close is missed, and gaps in history are repaired on their own.

strategies.title: 107 Pine Script strategies
strategies.description: Breakouts, pullbacks, divergences, mean reversion and momentum, written in Pine Script v5 and executed by a Pine engine on the backend. Tune parameters per strategy or drop your own .pine file into the strategies folder.

confluence.title: Confluence ladder
confluence.description: Per trading profile, list the conditions an entry must meet: indicator, threshold, timeframe, required or preferred. Required conditions must all pass and count double, and the score updates live next to the chart.

backtesting.title: Backtesting engine
backtesting.description: In the app, run any strategy on a symbol and timeframe over stored history with taker fees, trend, correlation and regime filters, and a cap on concurrent positions. From the command line, batch runs across strategies, symbols and timeframes, walk-forward and Monte Carlo.

autoTrading.title: Auto-trading with watchers
autoTrading.description: A watcher follows one symbol on one timeframe and opens a trade when a setup passes its profile, or only suggests it in semi-assisted mode. Rotate symbols by opportunity score, start the top 20 in one click, stop all with one button. An auto-scalping mode (beta) runs order-flow strategies on the 1m chart.

risk.title: Risk controls you set
risk.description: Fibonacci or swing-based targets and stops, minimum risk/reward, max risk per stop, daily loss limit and max drawdown limit, higher-timeframe and BTC-correlation filters, trailing stops, and liquidation warnings on open positions. Leverage and margin type are yours to set.

trading.title: Paper first, live when ready
trading.description: Paper wallets simulate fills and fees with the same flow as a live or testnet Binance wallet. Per-wallet analytics show performance, a daily P&L calendar and an equity curve that ignores deposits and withdrawals.

marketContext.title: Market context dashboard
marketContext.description: Fear & Greed, BTC dominance, MVRV, production cost, open interest, long/short ratio, altcoin season, ADX trend strength, order-book pressure and funding rates, each in its own panel.

screener.title: Screener and custom symbols (beta)
screener.description: Scan every symbol with 13 presets such as oversold uptrend, volume spike or breakout candidates, or build filters over 32 fields and save them. Compose custom indices from several symbols with weighted aggregation and chart them like any pair.

local.title: Runs on your machine
local.description: The desktop app talks to a backend and a PostgreSQL database that you run locally. API keys are encrypted at rest with AES-256 and never leave your computer. No account with us, no cloud.

agents.title: Built for AI agents too
agents.subtitle: Five Model Context Protocol servers expose the app, the database, the strategies and trade execution to Claude Code, ChatGPT desktop or any MCP client.

app.name: @marketmind/mcp-app
app.description: Drives the running app: navigate symbols, change timeframes and chart types, toggle indicators, open dialogs, switch themes.

backend.name: @marketmind/mcp-backend
backend.description: Read-only access to wallets, orders, executions, setups, watchers and candles, plus a tRPC bridge and the audit log.

strategy.name: @marketmind/mcp-strategy
strategy.description: List, create, diff and export Pine strategies, run backtests and read their results.

trading.name: @marketmind/mcp-trading
trading.description: Place and cancel orders, set stop-loss and take-profit, close positions and read wallet status, on paper wallets only.

screenshot.name: @marketmind/mcp-screenshot
screenshot.description: Captures any tab, dialog or sidebar in light and dark, with side-by-side galleries for visual checks.

safety.title: Writes are gated
safety.description: Agents can read everything. Trade execution is off by default, enabled per wallet, limited to paper wallets and 30 writes per hour, and every call lands in an audit log you can inspect in Settings.

download.title: Install the desktop app
download.description: Download the DMG for macOS or the installer for Windows from GitHub Releases. The macOS build is not notarized yet, so allow it once in System Settings. Later updates arrive through the app.

backend.title: Start the backend
backend.description: Clone the repository, start PostgreSQL with Docker Compose and run the backend. The quick start guide walks through it in five minutes.

connect.title: Connect a wallet
connect.description: Create a paper wallet to trade with simulated money, or add Binance API keys. Keys are encrypted and stored only on your computer, and live orders stay off until you enable them in the backend settings.

requirements.label: Requirements
requirements.node: Node.js 24 and pnpm for the backend

techStack.subtitle: TypeScript end to end: an Electron app, a Fastify backend and PostgreSQL for candle history.

openSource.title: Free and open source
openSource.subtitle: MIT licensed and developed in the open. Read the code, open an issue or send a pull request.

footer.description: Open-source trading workstation for Binance. Runs on your machine.
